scope: Direct visual transcription of every exterior color table printed for the 1997, 1998, 2004, and 2005 Chevrolet Express in the retained official General Motors vehicle information kits. Regular ZY1, SEO solid paint, YF7 upfitter, and cutaway tables remain separate. No color or restriction is projected across a body configuration, program, or model year.

method.source_integrity: Each reviewed PDF matched the SHA-256 and byte count in the retained GM Heritage artifact ledger.
method.code_policy: source_color_code preserves the chart's Color Code or Color Code 1 cell exactly. rpo_code repeats a printed regular paint code. seo_code repeats a printed SEO paint code. A literal source value of none is retained in source_color_code and is not converted into an inferred code.
method.absence_policy: A program marked not located documents only that no separate chart for that program was found in the complete reviewed kit. It does not prove that the program was unavailable through every ordering channel.

years.availability_scope: Complete printed regular ZY1 and SEO solid paint tables for Express Passenger, Express Cargo, Express Cargo YF7 Upfitter, and Express Cutaway. Each body configuration and paint program remains a separate palette record.
limitations: The regular color set is identical across the four reviewed configurations, but configuration specific restrictions remain attached to each palette record.
The SEO color set is identical across the four reviewed configurations. It is a specialty ordering program and is not presented as unrestricted retail availability.
No separate two tone exterior color table was located in the complete 276-page kit. This does not prove that every two tone treatment was unavailable.

The charts themselves carry publication dates from October 22, 2004, or March 4, 2005, despite appearing in the retained 2004 Express kit. The audit records those dates without changing the printed model year.
